definition: Data Applied was a software vendor headquartered in Washington.
details: Founded by a group of former Microsoft employees, the company specialized in data mining, data visualization, and business intelligence environments.
story: Imagine a chef tasting every ingredient before it goes into the pot, deciding what belongs and what would ruin the broth. Better ingredients make a better meal, and the same is true here. Every machine is shaped by what it was shown, so someone has to choose that material with care. It is the raw material; the model is only ever as good as what it was fed. And that is Data Applied — the unglamorous work everything else stands on.
